paper_container: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
question: In each untouched Target-522 Stage-A run partition, do materialized sibling-pair rows exceed the rank of the endpoint-edge incidence design by a predeclared material factor?

historical_exploration_disclosed_before_.why_not_confirmation: This historical split was examined before the threshold was fixed and includes 34 incomplete parent groups; it may motivate but cannot confirm the Target-522 claim.

estimand.name: pair-row inflation over endpoint-edge incidence rank
estimand.unit: one acquisition or evaluation sibling graph
estimand.formula_under_frozen_stage_a_certificate: For a disjoint union of complete sibling cliques with k_j endpoints per parent, pair rows equal sum_j k_j(k_j-1)/2 and endpoint-edge incidence rank equals sum_j(k_j-1)=endpoints-parents.
estimand.algebraic_note: pair_rows_per_rank >= 6/5 and redundant_pair_row_share >= 1/6 are exactly equivalent; the latter is reported for readability but is not counted as a second gate.

frozen_stage_a.source_semantics_proof: The frozen producer builds sibling_groups from the unique increment-card dictionary, assigning each endpoint identifier to exactly one task/run/parent key, and proves every observed group is its exact complete clique.
frozen_stage_a.required_scope: outcome-blind code and topology only; no public identities and no prospective scientific values

decision_rule.stage_a_support_requirement: Every frozen Stage-A support gate must be true; otherwise classify limited support regardless of observed ratios.
decision_rule.confirmed: TARGET522_LINEAR_CONTRAST_ROW_INFLATION_CONFIRMED iff every frozen Stage-A support gate is true and every confirmation gate passes independently in both acquisition and evaluation graphs.
decision_rule.not_confirmed: TARGET522_LINEAR_CONTRAST_ROW_INFLATION_NOT_CONFIRMED iff Stage-A support is complete but at least one graph confirmation gate fails.
decision_rule.limited_support: TARGET522_LINEAR_CONTRAST_RANK_AUDIT_LIMITED_SUPPORT iff any frozen Stage-A support gate fails.
decision_rule.multiplicity: One fixed descriptive claim evaluated once in each of two disjoint run partitions; no threshold, partition, task, or graph may be changed after Stage-A release.
decision_rule.uncertainty: This is deterministic census arithmetic over the frozen graphs, not a sampled label-performance estimate; no confidence interval is attached.

interpretation_boundary.allowed_if_confirmed: The future run-clean benchmark materializes materially more pair rows than endpoint-incidence contrast dimensions in both disjoint structural partitions; pair-row counts therefore overstate this exact linear contrast count unless clique dependence is accounted for.
not_claimed: the feature-matrix rank of every critic
algorithmic novelty for D-optimal or graph vertex sampling
interpretation_boundary.paper_role: A positive audit result can strengthen endpoint-cost accounting, clique 2/k weighting, and benchmark documentation; it does not replace the prospective predictor benchmark or first-960 closure.

resources.expected_single_cpu_seconds_after_stage_: under 10 excluding fresh full test suite
